description: This Java source file, 'MacroTreeRenderer', implements the TreeStringRenderer interface to render tree components using Freemarker macros within the OFBiz framework. It manages macro templates, renders boundary comments, nodes, labels, links, and images for tree structures in a web application by generating corresponding Freemarker macro calls.

classes.name: MacroTreeRenderer
classes.description: Implements a tree renderer using Freemarker macros for OFBiz, capable of rendering nodes, links, labels, images, and boundary comments within a hierarchical tree structure.

methods.name: MacroTreeRenderer
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the macro library template and environment for rendering Freemarker macros.

methods.name: executeMacro
methods.description: Private helper that compiles and includes a Freemarker macro string into the current environment for rendering.

methods.name: renderBeginningBoundaryComment
methods.description: Renders a boundary comment marking the beginning of a widget node.

methods.name: renderEndingBoundaryComment
methods.description: Renders a boundary comment marking the end of a widget node.

methods.name: renderNodeBegin
methods.description: Renders the start of a tree node, including boundary comments and expand/collapse logic.

methods.name: renderNodeEnd
methods.description: Renders the end of a tree node, including boundary comments if applicable.

methods.name: renderLastElement
methods.description: Renders the last element within the tree, typically some closing macro.

methods.name: renderLabel
methods.description: Renders a label for a tree node.

methods.name: renderLink
methods.description: Renders a hyperlink associated with a tree node, with optional image.

methods.name: renderImage
methods.description: Renders an image element within the tree node, constructing the appropriate URL.

methods.name: getScreenStringRenderer
methods.description: Returns a ScreenStringRenderer if available in the context, otherwise null.
